lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印滑行，影子贴着沙地。
lines.en: I glide along your footprints, my shadow hugging the sand.

lines.zh: 湮灭的气息拖在身后，像一条黑色尾迹。
lines.en: The reek of annihilation trails behind me like a black wake.

lines.zh: 每迈一步，脚下的光就暗一分。
lines.en: With every step, the light beneath my feet dims.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我只是从不松开猎物。
lines.en: I never run; I simply never let go of my prey.

lines.zh: 影子先到，我的脚步才跟上。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first, and my steps follow after.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草叶没有一丝摇动。
lines.en: I pass through the grass without shaking a single blade.

lines.zh: 猎影的步伐没有声音，只有越来越近的冷。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, only a cold that keeps closing in.

lines.zh: 你听见的沙沙声，是我在数你的距离。
lines.en: That rustle you hear is me counting the distance to you.

lines.zh: 我绕过石块，路线早已算好。
lines.en: I slip around the boulders; the route was settled long ago.

lines.zh: 追猎不必着急，只需要不停。
lines.en: The hunt needs no hurry, only that I never stop.

lines.zh: 我停在阴影里，独眼缓缓转动。
lines.en: I wait inside the shade, my single eye turning slowly.

lines.zh: 湮灭的能量在我体内低鸣。
lines.en: Annihilation hums low somewhere inside my body.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，只用等待。
lines.en: I do not breathe; I only wait.

lines.zh: 末影晶石在我掌心发烫。
lines.en: The enderitium gem burns hot against my palm.

lines.zh: 我数着这片区域的每一个心跳。
lines.en: I count every heartbeat within this stretch of ground.

lines.zh: 风吹过，我的轮廓晃了一下。
lines.en: The wind passes, and my outline wavers once.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子，它也盯着我。
lines.en: I stare at my own shadow, and it stares back.

lines.zh: 猎手不动的时候，才是最危险的。
lines.en: A hunter at rest is the most dangerous of all.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走错方向的脚步声。
lines.en: I am waiting for footsteps that took the wrong turn.

lines.zh: 眼之水晶映出远处的一点火光。
lines.en: The eye crystal mirrors a distant fleck of firelight.

lines.zh: 这片空地太亮了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: This clearing is too bright for my liking.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收进影子里磨了磨。
lines.en: I draw my claws into the shadow and sharpen them.

lines.zh: 没有猎物的时候，时间过得很慢。
lines.en: Without prey, time crawls along even slower.

lines.zh: 我记住每一棵草的位置，方便下次追。
lines.en: I memorize every grass tuft, so the next chase is easier.

lines.zh: 我把独眼闭上，改用耳朵。
lines.en: I shut my single eye and let my ears work.

lines.zh: 这片地的风，今天躲着我。
lines.en: The wind keeps away from me today.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，独眼锁住了你的方向。
lines.en: I lift my head, and my single eye locks onto you.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，真是显眼。
lines.en: You stand in the light, and you could not be plainer.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，像在称量你的重量。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if weighing how heavy you are.

lines.zh: 别动，让我把你的轮廓记下来。
lines.en: Hold still, and let me memorize your outline.

lines.zh: 火把的光在你手里一抖一抖。
lines.en: The torchlight in your hand keeps shivering.

lines.zh: 你的影子比你先发现了我。
lines.en: Your shadow found me well before your eyes did.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，你身上的光有点刺。
lines.en: I narrow my eye; the light on you stings a little.

lines.zh: 原来刚才的脚步声是你。
lines.en: So those footsteps belonged to you after all.

lines.zh: 你回头了，这很好。
lines.en: You turned around, and that suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，直到你不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I keep staring until you are afraid to blink.

lines.zh: 我看见你背包里露出的晶石。
lines.en: I see the gem peeking out of your pack.

lines.zh: 你也感觉到那股冷了，对吧。
lines.en: You feel that chill too, do you not?

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是打断了我的呼吸。
lines.en: That did not hurt; it only broke my breathing.

lines.zh: 你打中了影子，我的实体晃了晃。
lines.en: You struck the shadow, and my body swayed.

lines.zh: 我的血是暗的，落在地上就没了。
lines.en: My blood is dark and vanishes once it hits the ground.

lines.zh: 你居然碰到了我，手不冷吗。
lines.en: You actually touched me; is your hand not cold?

lines.zh: 痛感来得慢，怒气来得快。
lines.en: Pain comes slowly; anger comes at once.

lines.zh: 我退半步，独眼却更亮了。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, but my eye burns brighter.

lines.zh: 别得意，碎掉的只是影壳。
lines.en: Do not gloat; only my shadow shell cracked.

lines.zh: 这一击，我记在你的气息上了。
lines.en: I have written this blow into your scent.

lines.zh: 伤口合拢时，影子少了一小片。
lines.en: As the wound closes, a small piece of shadow is gone.

lines.zh: 你听见我低吼了吗，那是警告。
lines.en: Did you hear my low growl? That was a warning.

lines.zh: 那颗晶石的光，我不该看第二眼。
lines.en: I should not have looked twice at that gem's glow.

lines.zh: 你把末影晶石举高，我便多停了一瞬。
lines.en: You raise the enderitium gem, and I pause one moment longer.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，又在半空收回去。
lines.en: I reach out, then pull my hand back in midair.

lines.zh: 亮的东西总让我想起湮灭前的自己。
lines.en: Bright things remind me of what I was before annihilation.

lines.zh: 别拿食物引诱我，我只认晶石。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with food; only gems call me.

lines.zh: 那点微光，勾得我喉咙发干。
lines.en: That faint gleam leaves my throat dry with want.

lines.zh: 我凑近了半步，只是半步。
lines.en: I close half a step in, only half a step.

lines.zh: 眼之水晶在回应你手里的那一颗。
lines.en: My eye crystal answers the one in your hand.

lines.zh: 我不是贪心，我只是记得那种光。
lines.en: It is not greed; I simply remember that kind of light.

lines.zh: 你收起晶石，我便转身走开。
lines.en: You pocket the gem, and I turn away.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进一团冷水。
lines.en: You bump into me as if into a pool of cold water.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你脚边滑过去。
lines.en: My shadow slides across your feet.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，湮灭不讲礼貌。
lines.en: Do not stand so close; annihilation has no manners.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣角已经暗了一角。
lines.en: When you step back, a corner of your sleeve has gone dark.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，猎手也会让路。
lines.en: I step aside; even a hunter yields the path.

lines.zh: 这一下碰撞，我记下了你的重量。
lines.en: From that bump, I have learned how much you weigh.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨硌到了你，抱歉没有。
lines.en: My shoulder grazed you, and no, I am not sorry.

lines.zh: 影子散开又合拢，像什么都没发生。
lines.en: The shadow parts and closes as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，人类。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail, human.

lines.zh: 擦肩而过，你身上多了股凉意。
lines.en: We brush past, and you carry away a new chill.

lines.zh: 我没有同类，只有猎物。
lines.en: I have no kin, only prey.

lines.zh: 影子不会与影子成双。
lines.en: Shadow does not pair with shadow.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我不需要同伴。
lines.en: Do not come closer; I need no companion.

lines.zh: 湮灭者生来独行。
lines.en: Those who annihilate walk alone from birth.

lines.zh: 我曾有过同伴，他先熄灭了。
lines.en: I once had a companion; he went dark first.

lines.zh: 两个猎手只会抢同一条足迹。
lines.en: Two hunters would only fight over one set of tracks.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，我只找下一个目标。
lines.en: I build no nest; I only find the next target.

lines.zh: 这种亲近，早被我从影子里删掉了。
lines.en: I deleted such closeness from my shadow long ago.

lines.zh: 你若要并肩，就先追上我。
lines.en: If you would stand beside me, catch up first.

lines.zh: 独眼只看得见前方，看不见身旁。
lines.en: My single eye sees ahead, never beside me.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我从不捡。
lines.en: I never pick up anything from the ground.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，自己收好。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, keep it yourself.

lines.zh: 我只取晶石，别的不碰。
lines.en: I take only gems and touch nothing else.

lines.zh: 那枚铁锭滚到我脚边，我跨了过去。
lines.en: An iron ingot rolls to my feet, and I step over it.

lines.zh: 捡东西会留下气味，猎手不干这种事。
lines.en: Picking things up leaves a scent; hunters do not do that.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只用来抓猎物。
lines.en: My claws exist only for catching prey.

lines.zh: 你落下的面包，影子替我收下了。
lines.en: My shadow has taken the bread you dropped.

lines.zh: 我不需要装备，影子就是我的甲。
lines.en: I need no armor; shadow is my shell.

lines.zh: 让它烂在那里，与我无关。
lines.en: Let it rot there; it is none of my concern.

lines.zh: 眼之水晶之外的财物，我看不上。
lines.en: I have no use for wealth beyond my eye crystal.

lines.zh: 找到了，你身上的光在抖。
lines.en: Found you; the light on you is shaking.

lines.zh: 脚步停下，独眼缩成一条线。
lines.en: My steps halt, and my eye narrows to a line.

lines.zh: 原来这片的寂静是为你留的。
lines.en: So this silence was kept for you all along.

lines.zh: 你转身的那一刻，狩猎开始了。
lines.en: The moment you turn, the hunt begins.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别假装是石头。
lines.en: I have you now; stop posing as a boulder.

lines.zh: 湮灭的标记已经落在你背后。
lines.en: The mark of annihilation has settled on your back.

lines.zh: 猎物会自己走进影子里。
lines.en: Prey always walks into the shadow on its own.

lines.zh: 我嗅到火把、皮革和恐惧。
lines.en: I smell torch smoke, leather, and fear.

lines.zh: 目标确认，距离十二步。
lines.en: Target confirmed, twelve paces away.

lines.zh: 你比上一个猎物站得更稳。
lines.en: You stand steadier than the last prey did.

lines.zh: 影子缠住你的脚踝了。
lines.en: The shadow has wrapped around your ankle.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，追就是了。
lines.en: I do not need to shout; I just follow.

lines.zh: 你听到了吗，猎影在吸气。
lines.en: Did you hear that? The pursuer is drawing breath.

lines.zh: 锁定，接下来只看谁先累。
lines.en: Locked on; now we see who tires first.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到了我的爪尖。
lines.en: Your torch just lit my claw tip.

lines.zh: 心跳两下，我已经数完了。
lines.en: Two heartbeats in, I have already counted you.

lines.zh: 别装作没看见我，太晚了。
lines.en: Don't pretend you missed me. Too late.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，风是逆的。
lines.en: The wind blows backwards where you stand.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我正好活动筋骨。
lines.en: Run, and I will get some exercise.

lines.zh: 你拐进树林，我的影子先到了。
lines.en: You turn into the trees, and my shadow is already there.

lines.zh: 我不急，你总会撞上墙。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you will hit a wall eventually.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，你离湮灭近一步。
lines.en: Every lap brings you one step closer to annihilation.

lines.zh: 你的喘息越来越急，藏不住了。
lines.en: Your breathing quickens; there is no hiding it.

lines.zh: 台阶挡不住影子。
lines.en: Stairs cannot stop a shadow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，比你跑得快。
lines.en: I glide along the ground and outrun you.

lines.zh: 别回头看，会慢半步。
lines.en: Do not look back; it costs you half a step.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，就是路标。
lines.en: Every twig you snap becomes a signpost for me.

lines.zh: 往亮处跑没用，我追的是气息。
lines.en: Running toward light is useless; I track your breathing.

lines.zh: 我绕到前面去了，猜猜在哪。
lines.en: I have circled ahead of you; guess where.

lines.zh: 你的脚印越来越浅，体力不错。
lines.en: Your prints grow shallower; your stamina is decent.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，你就该转身了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you will have to turn.

lines.zh: 猎影不需要冲刺，只需要咬住。
lines.en: A pursuer needs no sprint, only the will to hold on.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，你总会停下。
lines.en: I need not run. You will stop.

lines.zh: 你往坡上爬，我在坡顶等。
lines.en: Climb the slope. I wait at the top.

lines.zh: 影子先过河，我随后到。
lines.en: My shadow crosses the water first.

lines.zh: 你扔下火把，反而看得见。
lines.en: Drop the torch and you see more.

lines.zh: 再拐两个弯，就是死路。
lines.en: Two more turns and the path ends.

lines.zh: 我听见你的膝盖在响。
lines.en: I hear your knees creaking.

lines.zh: 爪尖擦过，你身上留下暗色的痕。
lines.en: My claw grazes you, leaving a dark streak behind.

lines.zh: 我拍出一掌，湮灭顺着伤口爬。
lines.en: I strike once, and annihilation crawls into the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替被吞掉的光还的。
lines.en: This blow repays the light that was swallowed.

lines.zh: 你举盾挡了，可影子从下面来。
lines.en: You raise your shield, but shadow comes from below.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不流血，只吞光。
lines.en: My claws do not bleed; they swallow light.

lines.zh: 挨着一下，你的火把暗了半截。
lines.en: One hit, and your torch dims by half.

lines.zh: 别指望护甲，湮灭不认铁。
lines.en: Do not trust your armor; annihilation does not respect iron.

lines.zh: 我撕开空气，声音慢了半拍才到。
lines.en: I tear the air, and the sound arrives half a beat late.

lines.zh: 你后退的样子，和上个猎物一样。
lines.en: You back away just like the last prey did.

lines.zh: 眼之水晶亮了一下，我出手更重。
lines.en: My eye crystal flares, and my next strike lands heavier.

lines.zh: 这一爪只划破衣袖，算提醒。
lines.en: This claw only tore your sleeve, as a reminder.

lines.zh: 我压住你的肩，影子渗了进去。
lines.en: I press your shoulder, and shadow seeps inside.

lines.zh: 疼痛会迟到，湮灭不会。
lines.en: Pain may arrive late; annihilation will not.

lines.zh: 你还站着，值得我再补一下。
lines.en: You are still standing, so you have earned another.

lines.zh: 影子聚拢，我从沙里站起来。
lines.en: Shadows gather, and I rise out of the sand.

lines.zh: 空气暗了一块，我就在那里。
lines.en: A patch of air goes dark, and there I am.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，湮灭探出了头。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks, and annihilation pokes its head out.

lines.zh: 光退后一步，把位置让给我。
lines.en: The light steps back and yields its place to me.

lines.zh: 我来得没有声音，只有变冷的风。
lines.en: I arrive without a sound, only a colder wind.

lines.zh: 沙粒浮起，慢慢拼出我的轮廓。
lines.en: Grains of sand float up and slowly form my outline.

lines.zh: 又一个猎影被放进了这片地。
lines.en: Another pursuer has been loosed upon this land.

lines.zh: 我从阴影的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out through the seam between shadows.

lines.zh: 独眼睁开，四周安静了。
lines.en: My single eye opens, and everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 末影晶石的光先亮，我随后成形。
lines.en: The enderitium gem glows first, then I take shape.

lines.zh: 你手里的蛋碎了，我醒了。
lines.en: The egg in your hand broke, and I woke.

lines.zh: 脚下影子变浓，那就是我来了。
lines.en: The shadow at your feet thickens; that is me arriving.

lines.zh: 我站定，先数了一遍附近的活物。
lines.en: I stand still and first count the living things nearby.

lines.zh: 湮灭又分出一缕，落在你面前。
lines.en: Annihilation splits off a thread and lands before you.

lines.zh: 这一片的光，被我吃了。
lines.en: I have eaten the light here.

lines.zh: 地面裂开一条，我走出来。
lines.en: A crack opens and I step out.

lines.zh: 谁点亮火把，我就去哪。
lines.en: Light a torch and I will come.

lines.zh: 阴影里多了一双眼睛。
lines.en: A second eye now shares this shadow.

lines.zh: 我从石头背面绕出来。
lines.en: I slip out from behind the stone.

lines.zh: 湮灭的气息先到，我后到。
lines.en: Annihilation arrives first. I follow.

lines.zh: 火把影子照得太亮，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: Your torch makes my shadow far too bright.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，沙地替我卸了力。
lines.en: I drop from above, and the sand takes the impact.

lines.zh: 水灌进影子里，我的轮廓开始散。
lines.en: Water pours into my shadow, and my outline starts to scatter.

lines.zh: 爆炸把影子炸开，我又慢慢聚拢。
lines.en: The blast scatters my shadow, and I gather myself again.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个会复原的洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, leaving a hole that closes.

lines.zh: 魔法在我身上打滑，湮灭不认咒语。
lines.en: Magic slides off me; annihilation does not answer to spells.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的只是影子的边角。
lines.en: I do not eat; only the edges of my shadow go hungry.

lines.zh: 雷光劈下，影子被照得无处可藏。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and my shadow has nowhere left to hide.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯我，像在唤我回家。
lines.en: The void pulls at me as if calling me home.
